title: mad
summary: Compute mean or median absolute deviation.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider reduction hooks exist.

description: `mad(X)` computes mean absolute deviation from the mean. `mad(X,1)` computes median absolute deviation from the median. Dimension, vector-dimension, and `"all"` forms are supported.
behaviors: The default flag `0` uses mean absolute deviation from the mean.
Flag `1` uses median absolute deviation from the median.
NaNs are treated as missing and omitted from each slice by default.

faqs.question: What is the default deviation center?
faqs.answer: `mad(X)` uses the arithmetic mean as the center. Pass flag `1` to use the median.
